race.comment: MAGRITTE (2) held on well to finish second when first-up from a break last time out over 1200m at Beaudesert after leading for much of the way. Strips fitter second-up from the spell and is sure to go very well. TUXEDO TORPEDO (1) has been in the money two times including last start on August 29 when second over 1300m at this track. Yet to miss the top-three in two runs at this venue and can play a major role in the outcome. MISHANI CABELLO (10) finished 8 lengths away in fifth last time out over 1000m at Gold Coast two weeks ago. Steps up in distance today and gets in well at the weights with the 1.5kg claim. Right in this contest. O'REILLYS FLIGHT (3) is a two-start maiden who filled a minor placing at this circuit at the last run before spelling. Fitter following a trial win at Warwick and can kick off with a bold showing.
